posts.text: Tune in now 🚨 I’m joining @AmericaRpts live on Fox News to discuss the harrowing shooting at the White House Correspondents’ dinner and what lessons can be learned about security at major events.

Last night's shooting at the White House Correspondents' Dinner was another reminder that we must work together to lower the temperature and end political violence. I joined @BloombergTV to share my thoughts and describe the scene after shots rang out.

Video
I’m live on @CNN now with Dana Bash to discuss last night’s shooting at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner. Tune in 📺

I was at the White House Correspondents' Dinner this evening when shots were fired. Thanks to the swift response of Secret Service and @Capitolpolice, who escorted me from the premises, my congressional colleagues and I are safe. I’m incredibly grateful for their quick actions to protect all in attendance — including President Trump.
Tune in to Fox News! I’m live on set with @aishahhasnie to discuss the latest on U.S. negotiations with Iran and more.

I’m joining @BloombergTV LIVE on set to discuss the latest on negotiations with Iran and much more.

Today, I stood in front of 20,000 teddy bears on the national mall — each one representing an abducted Ukrainian child — to condemn Putin's brutality and remind the world of these children's plight.

Many of them are tortured, forced to memorize propaganda, and/or sent to the front lines to fight against their own country.

This is evil in its purest form. Now is the time for moral clarity, and history will judge us by how we respond.

My joint statement with @RepLuttrell on President Trump’s EO expanding access to ibogaine for veterans:

“Our veterans and special operators risked everything to defend our freedoms, yet too many return home to a lifetime of devastating pain and trauma. We have a profound moral obligation to help our heroes heal.
 
"That’s exactly what President Trump is doing through this revolutionary executive order, which once again proves his deep commitment to our veterans. Mounting evidence suggests that,

Every day, an average of 17 veterans take their own lives. Evidence is mounting that neuroplastogen treatments like Ibogaine can provide a durable path to healing where traditional medicine has failed. Today, I led a letter with @RepLuttrell urging @POTUS to provide our nation's heroes with greater access to this life-saving treatment.
